description: Installation of 2 no. internally illuminated hoarding signs
decision_conditions: The proposed hoarding signs, by virtue of their size, scale, siting and digital nature, would appear as overly-prominent and incongruous additions within the street scene, at odds with the prevailing character and appearance of advertisements in this location. The proposed advertisements would appear as visually intrusive, alien features in the street scene, bearing no relation to the historic context, and harmfully deviating from the existing and more traditional style and forms of advertisements exhibited and advocated for within the Ickenham Village Conservation Area and locality more generally. The proposal would thus detract from the visual amenity of the Conservation Area as well as the application building itself, which is considered to contribute positively to the Conservation Area.
